# package uamethod

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uamethod"
```

Package uamethod holds the contracts of Methods of the OPC UA namespace 0 (OPC 10000-5 and the Parts that define the types), generated by cmd/methods from the InputArguments and OutputArguments of the Method declarations of the NodeSet (internal/schema/Opc.Ua.NodeSet2.xml), for the ObjectTypes cmd/methods/config.go selects.

For each Method there is a [Method](#type-method) value with the NodeIds of the Method declaration and of its ObjectType and the declared arguments, an Input and an Output structure with Pack (to the \[]\*ua.Variant of a CallMethodRequest or CallMethodResult) and Unpack (from it, with the checks of the Call service: the number of arguments, their built-in type and their ValueRank), and a Call function that calls the Method with a client.

The Methods of FileType and FileDirectoryType (OPC 10000-20 §4.2, §4.3) are the first: the server package serves files with them (server.FileObject) and package filetransfer is the client.

## Functions

### func StatusOf

```go
func StatusOf(err error) ua.StatusCode
```

StatusOf returns the status an error of Unpack stands for, so a Method handler can return it: the Status of an \*ArgumentError, else Bad\_InvalidArgument. It returns StatusOK for nil.

## Types

### type ArgumentError

```go
type ArgumentError struct {
	// Method is "ObjectType.Name".
	Method string
	// Output reports an output argument, else an input argument.
	Output bool
	// Index is the position of the argument, -1 for the number of
	// arguments.
	Index int
	// Name is the name of the declared argument, "" for the number.
	Name string
	// Status is Bad_ArgumentsMissing, Bad_TooManyArguments or
	// Bad_TypeMismatch.
	Status ua.StatusCode
	// Detail says what was found.
	Detail string
}
```

ArgumentError is a list of arguments that does not match the declaration of a Method. Status is the code the Call service gives for it (Part 4 §5.12.2, Table 66 in 1.05.06): Bad\_ArgumentsMissing or Bad\_TooManyArguments for the number of arguments, Bad\_TypeMismatch for an argument of another built-in type or ValueRank.

#### func (ArgumentError) Error

```go
func (e *ArgumentError) Error() string
```

#### func (ArgumentError) Unwrap

```go
func (e *ArgumentError) Unwrap() error
```

Unwrap returns the status, so errors.Is(err, ua.StatusBadTypeMismatch) holds.

### type CallError

```go
type CallError struct {
	// Method is "ObjectType.Name".
	Method string
	// Status is the StatusCode of the CallMethodResult.
	Status ua.StatusCode
	// InputArgumentResults are the StatusCodes of the input arguments.
	InputArgumentResults []ua.StatusCode
}
```

CallError is a Bad StatusCode of the result of a call (Part 4 §5.12.2.2 in 1.05.06), with the result of each input argument when the server gave them.

#### func (CallError) Error

```go
func (e *CallError) Error() string
```

#### func (CallError) Unwrap

```go
func (e *CallError) Unwrap() error
```

Unwrap returns the status, so errors.Is(err, ua.StatusBadInvalidState) holds.

### type Caller

```go
type Caller interface {
	Call(ctx context.Context, req *ua.CallMethodRequest) (*ua.CallMethodResult, error)
}
```

Caller calls Methods: \*opcua.Client is one.

### type Method

```go
type Method struct {
	// Name is the BrowseName of the Method (its namespace is that of the
	// declaration).
	Name string
	// ObjectType is the BrowseName of the ObjectType that declares the
	// Method.
	ObjectType string
	// Namespace is the URI of the namespace of the declaration; "" is
	// namespace 0 (http://opcfoundation.org/UA/).
	Namespace string
	// ID and ObjectTypeID are the numeric identifiers of the Method and its
	// ObjectType in Namespace.
	ID, ObjectTypeID uint32
	// Clause is the clause of the specification that defines the Method,
	// from the Documentation of the declaration ("OPC 10000-20 §4.2.2").
	Clause string
	// Mandatory reports the ModellingRule Mandatory of the declaration
	// (Part 3 §6.4.4.5.2): every instance of the ObjectType has the Method.
	Mandatory bool

}
```

Method is the contract of a Method declaration: its BrowseName, the ObjectType it is a component of, and its arguments (Part 3 §5.7.1, the Argument DataType of §8.6).

#### func (Method) Call

```go
func (m *Method) Call(ctx context.Context, c Caller, obj, method *ua.NodeID, in []*ua.Variant) ([]*ua.Variant, error)
```

Call calls m on the Object obj with the input arguments in, and returns the output arguments as the server sent them (the generated Call functions unpack them). method is the NodeId of the Method to call; nil calls the declaration of namespace 0, which the server maps to the Method of obj: "the methodId is either the NodeId of the Method that is a component of the Object instance or the NodeId of the Method in the ObjectType that defines the Method" (Part 4 §5.12.2.2 in 1.05.06). A Bad result is a \*CallError.

#### func (Method) InputArguments

```go
func (m *Method) InputArguments() []*ua.Argument
```

InputArguments returns the value of the InputArguments Property of the declaration, nil when the Method has no input arguments. The slice and the Arguments are new on each call.

#### func (Method) NodeID

```go
func (m *Method) NodeID(ns uint16) *ua.NodeID
```

NodeID returns the NodeId of the Method declaration with the namespace index ns: 0 for namespace 0, else the index the server has for Namespace.

#### func (Method) ObjectTypeNodeID

```go
func (m *Method) ObjectTypeNodeID(ns uint16) *ua.NodeID
```

ObjectTypeNodeID returns the NodeId of the ObjectType of the Method with the namespace index ns.

#### func (Method) OutputArguments

```go
func (m *Method) OutputArguments() []*ua.Argument
```

OutputArguments returns the value of the OutputArguments Property of the declaration, nil when the Method has no output arguments.

#### func (Method) String

```go
func (m *Method) String() string
```

String returns "ObjectType.Name".
